name: Nimora – AI SEO, Product Media & Analytics
author: codefreex

sections.description:
Nimora gives WooCommerce teams one operating flow to find shopper hesitation, repair ranking leaks, generate product media, and publish approved work back to WordPress and WooCommerce.

Install once, connect your store, and use Nimora to improve WooCommerce SEO, image optimization, product metadata, JSON-LD structured data, AI blog content, UGC images, product videos, visitor analytics, session replays, and heatmaps from one clean workspace.

Start free with 50 watermark-free AI image generations for product visuals, lifestyle shots, and UGC-style creative. Use live WooCommerce catalog data so every generated asset starts from the product title, description, and images your team already trusts.

Nimora is built for store owners, ecommerce marketers, agencies, and content teams that want better organic visibility, faster product launches, richer product pages, and clearer conversion signals without juggling separate SEO, analytics, and creative tools.

WooCommerce SEO and image optimizer

Nimora scans your WordPress and WooCommerce store for issues that hurt rankings and click-through rate:

  • WooCommerce SEO audits and product optimization.
  • Missing meta titles and meta descriptions.
  • Product image alt text gaps.
  • Broken links and weak internal paths.
  • JSON-LD structured data gaps.
  • PageSpeed and image optimization opportunities.
  • Product page SEO issues that can be reviewed and fixed in bulk.

UGC images, product videos, and AI content

Turn one WooCommerce product into fresh product media and content without leaving your operating flow:

  • Generate UGC-style product images with no Nimora watermark.
  • Create studio, lifestyle, minimalist, and ad-ready product photos.
  • Generate short product videos and reels for ecommerce campaigns.
  • Draft SEO blogs, landing page copy, product descriptions, and topical content.
  • Use product context from WooCommerce titles, descriptions, and existing images.
  • Keep approved assets in Nimora and publish or attach them back when ready.

Analytics, replays, and heatmaps

Nimora helps you see where visitors hesitate before paid traffic turns into waste:

  • Session replays for real buyer journeys.
  • Click, scroll, and movement heatmaps.
  • Live visitors and page behavior.
  • Storefront analytics for sessions, clicks, scroll depth, and visitor behavior.
  • Ecommerce conversion insights from one connected workspace.

Tracking and session recordings are optional and off by default. Store owners can enable them only when their privacy policy and consent requirements are ready.

Why merchants choose Nimora

Most ecommerce stores use separate tools for WooCommerce SEO, image optimizer workflows, product metadata, image alt text, analytics, schema, AI content, UGC images, and product videos. Nimora brings these workflows into one AI-powered ecommerce workspace.

Nimora helps store owners and agencies move from finding the issue to shipping the fix: spot the leak, repair the SEO problem, create the next asset, and publish approved work back to WordPress or WooCommerce.

Key features

  • WooCommerce SEO audit for products, pages, metadata, alt text, broken links, JSON-LD, and speed opportunities.
  • Image optimizer and product image SEO workflows for alt text and catalog visibility.
  • UGC images, product photos, and product videos generated from live catalog context.
  • AI blog creator, keyword ideas, topical maps, and landing page content for ecommerce SEO.
  • Optional session replays, heatmaps, live visitors, and storefront analytics.
  • Publish-back support for WordPress posts, pages, media, WooCommerce products, metadata, and schema.
  • Signed server-side connection with WooCommerce REST API keys and optional WordPress application password.
  • Free start with 50 watermark-free AI image generations for product creative.

Privacy, security, and source transparency

This plugin uses WordPress HTTP APIs, REST routes, capabilities, sanitization, escaping, nonces, and GPL-compatible code.

The plugin does not include obfuscated code, hidden tracking, or remote code loading.

Secrets are stored server-side in WordPress options and are never exposed to storefront visitors.

Storefront analytics and session recordings are off by default. They are only loaded after a site administrator explicitly enables the relevant settings.

External services

This plugin connects to the Nimora service after a site administrator configures the plugin and saves the connection settings.

Nimora is an external ecommerce AI SEO, analytics, content, and media workspace operated by Codefreex.

Service URL: https://www.nimora.us

The plugin uses Nimora to authenticate the site connection and power approved workflows such as SEO audits, metadata updates, image alt text, JSON-LD schema, AI content, product media, analytics, and publish-back actions.

During the administrator-triggered connection flow, the plugin sends the site URL, site name, administrator email, WooCommerce REST credentials if provided, optional WordPress application password if provided, and a plugin secret to Nimora so the external service can authenticate the site and perform approved workflows.

Storefront analytics are off by default. If a site administrator explicitly opts in to storefront analytics, the plugin may send the following data to Nimora:

  • Site URL and connection status.
  • WordPress post, page, media, and product identifiers.
  • Selected WooCommerce product data needed for enabled workflows.
  • Selected SEO metadata and structured data payloads.
  • Media upload and publishing payloads.
  • Approved publish-back requests.
  • Storefront analytics events such as page views, clicks, scroll depth, and session activity when tracking is enabled.
  • Session replay events only if the administrator separately opts in to session recordings.

No WooCommerce API keys, WordPress application passwords, or plugin secrets are exposed to browser-side scripts.

Nimora is only used after an administrator configures the plugin. Publish-back actions require signed requests and authorized workflows.

Terms of Service: https://www.nimora.us/terms

Privacy Policy: https://www.nimora.us/privacy

JavaScript source code

The plugin includes the following JavaScript assets:

  • assets/nimora-tracker.js is human-readable source included directly in this plugin package.
  • assets/rrweb.min.js is the bundled browser recorder from the open-source rrweb project and is only enqueued when a site administrator explicitly enables session recordings. Source code is publicly available at https://github.com/rrweb-io/rrweb. The bundled file corresponds to the rrweb package used by the Nimora web application dependency tree, rrweb version 2.0.0-alpha.4, as installed from npm.

To inspect or rebuild rrweb from source, clone the rrweb repository or install the npm package:

npm install rrweb@2.0.0-alpha.4<h3>Free and paid usage</h3>

The Nimora WordPress plugin is free to install.

A Nimora account is required to connect your site to the Nimora service.

Nimora may offer Free, Pro, Business, and Rockstar service plans for different limits and workflows such as AI SEO, analytics, image alt text, content generation, product media, and advanced ecommerce automation.

Paid plans apply to the Nimora SaaS service. They do not unlock hidden GPL code inside this WordPress plugin.

Privacy

Nimora may process site, product, content, media, metadata, structured data, and analytics information depending on the features enabled by the site administrator.

Site owners are responsible for updating their privacy policy and consent notices based on the Nimora features they enable.

The plugin stores connection credentials server-side and does not expose plugin secrets, WooCommerce consumer secrets, or WordPress application passwords to storefront visitors.

Storefront analytics and session recordings are off by default and require explicit administrator opt-in before any visitor analytics scripts are loaded.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nimora folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP file from your WordPress admin.
  2. Activate Nimora – AI SEO, Product Media & Analytics.
  3. Go to Settings > Nimora.
  4. Confirm the locked Nimora API server shown on the settings page.
  5. For WooCommerce product workflows, create WooCommerce REST API keys with Read/Write access.
  6. Paste the WooCommerce consumer key and consumer secret into the Nimora settings page.
  7. For WordPress post, page, and media publishing, optionally create a WordPress application password.
  8. Save the settings and connect your site.
  9. Optional: enable Storefront analytics if you want visitor events sent to Nimora. This is off by default.
  10. Optional: enable Session recordings if you want replay events sent to Nimora. This is off by default and only works when Storefront analytics is also enabled.
  11. Open the Nimora dashboard from the WordPress settings page.
sections.faq:
How do I create WooCommerce REST API keys?

From the WordPress admin, go to WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API, click Add key, choose the admin user, set permissions to Read/Write, and generate the key. Copy the Consumer Key and Consumer Secret into Settings > Nimora.

How do I create a WordPress application password?

From the WordPress admin, go to Users > Profile, find Application Passwords, enter Nimora as the application name, and click Add New Application Password. Copy the generated password once and paste it into Settings > Nimora.

Does Nimora require WooCommerce?

No. Nimora can connect a WordPress-only site for content, publishing, media, and site-level workflows. WooCommerce is required for product catalog syncing, product SEO automation, and product media publishing.

Does Nimora require a Nimora account?

Yes. The plugin connects your WordPress site to the Nimora service.

What is Nimora used for?

Nimora helps ecommerce teams manage WooCommerce SEO audits, product metadata, image alt text, JSON-LD schema, analytics, AI content, UGC images, product videos, and product media workflows from one connected dashboard.

Do free images include a watermark?

No. Nimora starts stores with 50 free watermark-free AI image generations for product photos and UGC-style creative, subject to the current Nimora service limits.

Can Nimora help with WooCommerce SEO?

Yes. Nimora can support WooCommerce product SEO workflows such as product metadata reviews, product title optimization, image alt text workflows, structured data, and approved publish-back actions.

Can Nimora generate image alt text?

Nimora supports image alt text workflows for ecommerce and product media. This helps store owners improve image SEO, accessibility, and product content quality.

Can Nimora publish JSON-LD schema?

Yes. Nimora can store and publish approved JSON-LD structured data payloads for supported WordPress and WooCommerce workflows.

Does Nimora track visitors?

Nimora can support lightweight storefront analytics only when tracking is explicitly enabled by the site administrator. Tracking is off by default. Events may include page views, clicks, scroll depth, and session activity. Session recordings require a separate opt-in checkbox. Site owners should review their privacy policy and consent requirements before enabling visitor tracking.

Are WooCommerce API keys exposed to visitors?

No. WooCommerce REST API credentials, WordPress application passwords, and Nimora plugin secrets are stored server-side in WordPress options and are not exposed in browser-side tracking code.

Does Nimora automatically change my website?

No. Nimora only performs write-back actions through authorized and signed requests after the site has been connected and the relevant workflow has been approved.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

Nimora is designed to work with common WordPress and WooCommerce SEO metadata patterns, including standard WordPress meta fields and popular SEO plugin metadata where available.

Can I disconnect Nimora?

Yes. Go to Settings > Nimora and disconnect the site. You can also deactivate or uninstall the plugin from WordPress.

Is the plugin free?

Yes. The WordPress plugin is free to install. Nimora service plans may include free and paid tiers depending on usage, credits, and advanced workflows.
sections.changelog:
0.1.12

  • Added featured-image import for AI blog posts published from Nimora.
  • Preserves accessible image alt text when Nimora assigns the imported image to the WordPress post.

0.1.11

  • Synced the latest Nimora storefront tracker for more reliable heatmap and replay capture across connected storefronts.
  • Improved compatibility with the current Nimora analytics and reporting release.

0.1.10

  • Synced tracker scroll-depth initialization so Shopify, WooCommerce, and WordPress heatmaps show page activity sooner.
  • Improved storefront snapshot status handling when a screenshot cannot be captured immediately.

0.1.9

  • Synced the latest Nimora storefront tracker for improved heatmap screenshot capture.
  • Improved WooCommerce product media attach reliability, file type handling, alt text, and gallery updates.

0.1.6

  • Reworked the WordPress.org readme into merchant-facing WooCommerce SEO and AI media listing copy.
  • Highlighted image optimizer, UGC images, product videos, and watermark-free image generation.
  • Restored the standard WordPress.org banner asset alongside the high-resolution banner.

0.1.5

  • Added WordPress.org PNG icon assets so the plugin logo displays reliably in listings.
  • Improved readme tags and screenshot captions for WooCommerce SEO, image optimizer, UGC images, and product videos.

0.1.4

  • Locked the Nimora API server URL in the settings screen.
  • Added guided WooCommerce REST API and WordPress application password setup instructions.
  • Updated WordPress.org screenshots, banner, and icon assets for the plugin listing.

0.1.3

  • Made storefront analytics and session recordings explicit opt-in settings that are off by default.
  • Documented bundled JavaScript source code for WordPress.org review.
  • Improved credential sanitization without altering application password and secret characters.

0.1.2

  • Bundled the Nimora tracker locally for canonical visitor, heatmap, and session replay payloads.
  • Added a WordPress admin recording toggle that still respects Nimora plan and dashboard settings.
  • Improved multi-platform tracking compatibility for WooCommerce and WordPress storefronts.

0.1.1

  • Updated WordPress.org metadata and readme positioning.
  • Improved SEO-focused description for AI SEO, product media, analytics, schema, image alt text, and WooCommerce workflows.
  • Added clearer external service, free/paid usage, and privacy disclosure sections.
  • Improved setup guidance for WordPress and WooCommerce connections.

0.1.0

  • Initial release with Nimora connection settings.
  • Added signed REST connection support.
  • Added WooCommerce product endpoint support.
  • Added WordPress post, page, and media publishing support.
  • Added JSON-LD structured data storage support.
  • Added lightweight storefront tracking support.
